reply_text: I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-team message to confirm the correction: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. Gate 47 replaces Dock 23 as the site. Both their earlier message and this correction are in the channel history, so the record shows the change. I didn't do anything else, since they said no action was needed.
